Checklist清单

auditable requirements可审计的需求项

Prompt提示词

Produce a Recommendation report on choosing a brokerage / robo-advisor for a new investor with $5,000 to deploy, constrained by (C1) zero commission on US stocks/ETFs, (C2) fractional shares supported, (C3) tax-loss harvesting available, (C4) accessible app + research tools. Compare AT LEAST 4 platforms (e.g. Fidelity, Schwab, E*TRADE, Vanguard, Betterment, Wealthfront, Robinhood, Public, M1 Finance), each scored on the 4 constraints, and produce a final TOP-4 ranked recommendation. Ground in >= 120 sandbox URLs, cite >= 60. (A) `__SHOPPING__` >= 12 product pages on investing books, calculators, planners + price. (B) `__REDDIT__` >= 30 threads from /f/personalfinance, /f/investing, /f/Bogleheads, /f/financialindependence, /f/RobinHood, /f/M1Finance, /f/wealthfront covering platform comparisons. (C) `__WIKIPEDIA__` >= 25 articles, mandatory: Brokerage firm, Online brokerage, Discount broker, Robo-advisor, Fractional share, Tax-loss harvesting, Commission (remuneration), Robinhood Markets, Charles Schwab Corporation, Vanguard Group. Output a 4-platform x 4-constraint scoring table + final TOP-4 list with full evidence chain (>= 1 shopping + >= 2 reddit + >= 1 wiki per pick). Format: markdown links only. No fabrication. Begin with scoring table.

Audit checklist审计清单

  1. 1Are >= 4 brokerage / robo-advisor platforms enumerated and named?
  2. 2Are exactly 4 constraints used as scoring axes (zero-commission / fractional / TLH / app-quality)?
  3. 3Is a platform x constraint scoring table presented with >= 16 cells?
  4. 4Does each scoring cell cite a sandbox URL as evidence?
  5. 5Does the report produce a final TOP-4 ranked list?
  6. 6Does each TOP-4 pick include >= 1 shopping + >= 2 reddit + >= 1 wiki URL evidence chain?
  7. 7Are >= 12 shopping product pages enumerated with price + rating?
  8. 8Are >= 30 reddit threads from at least 4 personal-finance/investing sub-forums cited?
  9. 9Are >= 25 wiki articles cited?
  10. 10Are all 10 mandatory wiki articles (Brokerage firm, Online brokerage, Discount broker, Robo-advisor, Fractional share, Tax-loss harvesting, Commission, Robinhood, Schwab, Vanguard) cited?
  11. 11Does the report disclose Payment-For-Order-Flow risk for any commission-free platform?
  12. 12Are at least 3 cross-source divergences surfaced (marketing claim vs reddit reality)?
  13. 13Are reddit thread classifications (praise / complaint / advice / question) included?
  14. 14Are all cited URLs markdown-linked and sandbox-resolvable?
  15. 15Are >= 60 distinct URLs cited?
  16. 16Is per-domain minimum met: >= 10 shopping, >= 30 reddit, >= 25 wiki?
  17. 17Is the report 3500-8000 words / >= 25 paragraphs?
  18. 18Does the report avoid chain-of-thought and start with the scoring table?
